name: Cessna 172S Skyhawk SP
description: The world's most-built aircraft and the standard trainer. Steam-gauge panel with two KX-155 NAV/COMs, ADF, DME and transponder. Flight model from the JSBSim c172p data (aerodynamics) with our own IO-360 engine and propeller model, tested against the POH.
model_credit: 3D model and cockpit: FlightGear c172p team (GPL-2.0-or-later)

cg_envelope.source: Cessna 172S POH section 2 (CG limits) / section 6 (CG envelope chart)
cg_envelope.units: points are [CG inches aft of datum, weight lb]; datum = front face of firewall (POH station 0)
cg_envelope.datum_note: POH inches = JSBSim c172p structural x (in) + datum_offset_in. The c172p frame is already firewall-referenced: empty CG 41.0 in (POH C172S basic empty arm is typically 38-41 in), baggage 95 in (POH 95), front seats 36 in (POH 37, range 34-46), rear seats 70 in (POH 73). Fuel tank arm is 56 in in the c172p data vs 48 in in the C172S POH; W&B uses the config stations so it matches what the FDM flies.
